0.1.tren: Fadhkuruni adhkurkum washkuru li wa la takfurun · Ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanudh-kurullaha dhikran kathira · Wadh-dhakirinallaha kathiran wadh-dhakirati a'addallahu lahum maghfiratan wa ajran 'azima · Wadhkur rabbaka fi nafsika tadarru'an wa khifatan wa dunal-jahri minal-qawli bil-ghuduwwi wal-asali wa la takun minal-ghafilin
0.1.en: [Allah the Exalted says:] So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me. · O you who have believed, remember Allah with much remembrance. · And the men who remember Allah often and the women who do so – for them Allah has prepared forgiveness and a great reward. · And remember your Lord within yourself in humility and in fear without being apparent in speech – in the mornings and the evenings. And do not be among the heedless.

11.2.en: Peace be upon you, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.

14.2.en: O Allah, protect me from the accursed devil.

16.7.tren: Allahumma inni as'aluka imanan la yartaddu, wa na'iman la yanfadu, wa murafaqata Muhammadin sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam fi a'la jannatil-khuld
16.7.en: [May be said between recitation in the night (tahajjud) prayer or when praying alone] O Allah, I ask You for faith that does not turn back, bliss that does not run out, and the companionship of Muhammad ﷺ in the highest level of the Garden of Eternity.

19.8.tren: Allahummaj-'al fi qalbi nura, wa fi sam'i nura, wa fi basari nura, wa 'an yamini nura, wa 'an shimali nura, wa amami nura, wa khalfi nura, wa fawqi nura, wa tahti nura, waj-'al li nura, (waj-'alni nura), waj-'al fi nafsi nura, (wa fi 'asabi nura, wa fi lahmi nura, wa fi dami nura, wa fi sha'ri nura, wa fi bashari nura), Allahumma a'tini nura
19.8.en: O Allah, place light in my heart, light in my hearing, light in my sight, light on my right, light on my left, light in front of me, light behind me, light above me and light beneath me. Grant me light, (make me light), and place light in my soul, (light in my sinews, light in my flesh, light in my blood, light in my hair and light in my skin). O Allah, give me light.

22.2.tren: At-tahiyyatu lillahi was-salawatu wat-tayyibat. As-salamu 'alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh. As-salamu 'alayna wa 'ala 'ibadillahis-salihin. (Fa idha qalaha asabat kulla 'abdin lillahi salihin fis-sama'i wal-ard.) Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh. (Thumma yatakhayyaru minal-mas'alati ma sha')
22.2.en: [When you sit in prayer, say:] All greetings, prayers and good things are for Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah. (When he says this, it reaches every righteous servant of Allah in the heavens and the earth.) I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. (Then let him choose whatever supplication he wishes.)

23.3.tren: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin ('abdika wa rasulika) (an-nabiyyil-ummiyyi) wa 'ala ali Muhammadin kama sallayta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Ibrahima innaka Hamidun Majid, wa barik 'ala Muhammadin ('abdika wa rasulika) (an-nabiyyil-ummiyyi) wa 'ala ali Muhammadin kama barakta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Ibrahima innaka Hamidun Majid
23.3.en: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad (Your servant and Messenger) (the unlettered Prophet) and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; indeed, You are Worthy of Praise, Full of Glory. And send blessings upon Muhammad (Your servant and Messenger) (the unlettered Prophet) and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; indeed, You are Worthy of Praise, Full of Glory.

23.4.tren: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammadin kama sallayta 'ala ali Ibrahima innaka Hamidun Majid. Allahumma barik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammadin kama barakta 'ala ali Ibrahima innaka Hamidun Majid
23.4.en: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon the family of Ibrahim; indeed, You are Worthy of Praise, Full of Glory. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon the family of Ibrahim; indeed, You are Worthy of Praise, Full of Glory.

23.5.tren: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala azwajihi wa dhurriyyatihi kama sallayta 'ala ali Ibrahim, wa barik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala azwajihi wa dhurriyyatihi kama barakta 'ala ali Ibrahima innaka Hamidun Majid
23.5.en: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon his wives and his offspring, as You sent prayers upon the family of Ibrahim. And send blessings upon Muhammad and upon his wives and his offspring, as You sent blessings upon the family of Ibrahim; indeed, You are Worthy of Praise, Full of Glory.

24.12.tren: Allahumma allif bayna qulubina, wa aslih dhata baynina, wahdina subulas-salam, wa najjina minaz-zulumati ilan-nur, wa jannibnal-fawahisha ma zahara minha wa ma batan, wa barik lana fi asma'ina wa absarina wa qulubina wa azwajina wa dhurriyyatina, wa tub 'alayna innaka antat-Tawwabur-Rahim, waj-'alna shakirina li-ni'matika muthnina biha qabiliha, wa atimmaha
24.12.en: O Allah, join our hearts together, set right our relations with one another, guide us to the paths of peace, deliver us from darkness into light, and keep us away from immoralities, the apparent and the hidden. Bless us in our hearing, our sight, our hearts, our spouses and our offspring, and accept our repentance; indeed, You are the Accepter of Repentance, the Most Merciful. Make us grateful for Your blessings, praising You for them and receiving them, and complete them.

24.13.tren: Allahumma inni as'aluka minal-khayri kullihi, 'ajilihi wa ajilihi, ma 'alimtu minhu wa ma lam a'lam, wa a'udhu bika minash-sharri kullihi, 'ajilihi wa ajilihi, ma 'alimtu minhu wa ma lam a'lam. Allahumma inni as'aluka min khayri ma sa'alaka 'abduka wa nabiyyuka (Muhammadun sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam), wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma 'adha bihi 'abduka wa nabiyyuka (Muhammadun sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam). Allahumma inni as'alukal-jannata wa ma qarraba ilayha min qawlin aw 'amal, wa a'udhu bika minan-nari wa ma qarraba ilayha min qawlin aw 'amal, wa as'aluka ma qadayta li min amrin an taj'ala 'aqibatahu rashada
24.13.en: O Allah, I ask You for all good, the immediate and the delayed, what I know of it and what I do not know, and I seek refuge in You from all evil, the immediate and the delayed, what I know of it and what I do not know. O Allah, I ask You for the good of what Your servant and Prophet (Muhammad ﷺ) asked You for, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of what Your servant and Prophet (Muhammad ﷺ) sought refuge in You from. O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and whatever word or deed brings one closer to it, and I seek refuge in You from the Fire and whatever word or deed brings one closer to it. And I ask You to make the outcome of every matter You have decreed for me good.

25.9.tren: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayta, wa la mu'tiya lima mana'ta, wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd
25.9.en: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, and none can give what You withhold, and the fortune of the fortunate is of no avail against You.

25.10.tren: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah. La ilaha illallahu wa la na'budu illa iyyah, lahun-ni'matu wa lahul-fadlu wa lahuth-thana'ul-hasan. La ilaha illallahu mukhlisina lahud-dina wa law karihal-kafirun
25.10.en: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. There is no might and no power except by Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and we worship none except Him. To Him belong all favour, grace and fair praise. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah; we are sincere in making our religion His, even though the disbelievers detest it.

25.11.en: My Lord, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect (gather) Your servants.

25.12.tren: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqri, wa a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabr
25.12.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave.

25.13.tren: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik
25.13.en: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You in the best manner.

25.14.tren: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-bukhl, wa a'udhu bika minal-jubn, wa a'udhu bika min an uradda ila ardhalil-'umur, wa a'udhu bika min fitnatid-dunya, wa a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabr
25.14.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from miserliness, I seek refuge in You from cowardice, I seek refuge in You from being returned to the most decrepit old age, I seek refuge in You from the trials of this world, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave.

25.15.tren: Allahummagh-fir li ma qaddamtu wa ma akhkhartu, wa ma asrartu wa ma a'lantu, wa ma asraftu, wa ma anta a'lamu bihi minni. Antal-Muqaddimu wa antal-Mu'akhkhiru, la ilaha illa ant
25.15.en: O Allah, forgive me what I have done before and what I have left undone, what I have done in secret and what I have done openly, what I have done in excess, and what You know better than I. You are the One who brings forward and You are the One who puts back. None has the right to be worshipped except You.

25.16.tren: Allahumma aslih li diniyal-ladhi ja'altahu 'ismata amri, wa aslih li dunyayal-lati ja'alta fiha ma'ashi. Allahumma a'udhu biridaka min sakhatik, wa bi'afwika min niqmatik, wa a'udhu bika mink. Allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayta, wa la mu'tiya lima mana'ta, wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd
25.16.en: O Allah, set right for me my religion, which You have made the safeguard of my affairs, and set right for me my worldly life, in which You have placed my livelihood. O Allah, I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your anger, and in Your pardon from Your punishment, and I seek refuge in You from You. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, and none can give what You withhold, and the fortune of the fortunate is of no avail against You.

25.17.tren: Allahumma bika uhawilu, wa bika uqatilu, wa bika usawil
25.17.en: O Allah, by You I strive, by You I fight, and by You I assail.

25.18.tren: Allahummagh-fir li wa tub 'alayya innaka antat-Tawwabur-Rahim (at-Tawwabul-Ghafur)
25.18.en: [100 times] O Allah, forgive me and accept my repentance; indeed, You are the Accepter of Repentance, the Most Merciful (the Accepter of Repentance, the Most Forgiving).

25.19.tren: Allahummagh-fir li dhunubi wa khatayaya kullaha. Allahumman-'ishni wajburni wahdini li-salihil-a'mali wal-akhlaq, fa innahu la yahdi li-salihiha wa la yasrifu sayyi'aha illa ant
25.19.en: O Allah, forgive me all my sins and errors. O Allah, revive me, mend me, and guide me to righteous deeds and good character, for none guides to the best of them and none turns away the worst of them except You.

25.20.tren: Allahumma aslih li dini (ighfir li dhanbi) wa wassi' li fi dari wa barik li fi rizqi
25.20.en: O Allah, set right my religion for me (forgive me my sin), make my home spacious for me, and bless me in my provision.

25.21.tren: Allahumma rabba Jibrila wa Mika'ila wa Israfil, a'idhni min harrin-nari wa 'adhabil-qabr
25.21.en: O Allah, Lord of Jibril, Mika'il and Israfil, protect me from the heat of the Fire and the punishment of the grave.

25.22.tren: Allahumma inni as'aluka minal-khayri kullihi ma 'alimtu minhu wa ma lam a'lam, wa a'udhu bika minash-sharri kullihi ma 'alimtu minhu wa ma lam a'lam
25.22.en: O Allah, I ask You for all good, what I know of it and what I do not know, and I seek refuge in You from all evil, what I know of it and what I do not know.

25.23.en: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there to Him any equivalent."

25.24.tren: Allahumma rabbana wa rabba kulli shay'in, ana shahidun annaka antar-Rabbu wahdaka la sharika lak. Allahumma rabbana wa rabba kulli shay'in, ana shahidun anna Muhammadan 'abduka wa rasuluk. Allahumma rabbana wa rabba kulli shay'in, ana shahidun annal-'ibada kullahum ikhwah. Allahumma rabbana wa rabba kulli shay'in, ij'alni mukhlisan laka wa ahli fi kulli sa'atin fid-dunya wal-akhirah, ya Dhal-Jalali wal-Ikram, isma' wastajib. Allahu akbarul-akbar. Allahumma Nuras-samawati wal-ard (Rabbas-samawati wal-ard). Allahu akbarul-akbar. Hasbiyallahu wa ni'mal-wakil. Allahu akbarul-akbar
25.24.en: O Allah, our Lord and Lord of all things, I bear witness that You are the Lord, alone, without partner. O Allah, our Lord and Lord of all things, I bear witness that Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger. O Allah, our Lord and Lord of all things, I bear witness that all the servants are brothers. O Allah, our Lord and Lord of all things, make me and my family sincere to You at every moment in this world and the Hereafter. O Possessor of Majesty and Honour, hear and answer. Allah is the Greatest, the Most Great. O Allah, Light of the heavens and the earth (Lord of the heavens and the earth). Allah is the Greatest, the Most Great. Allah is sufficient for me, and He is the best Disposer of affairs. Allah is the Greatest, the Most Great.

25.25.tren: Subhana rabbika rabbil-'izzati 'amma yasifun, wa salamun 'alal-mursalin, wal-hamdu lillahi rabbil-'alamin
25.25.en: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe. And peace upon the messengers. And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

25.26.tren: (Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah) Bismillahil-ladhi la ilaha ghayruhur-Rahmanir-Rahim. Allahumma adh-hib 'annil-hamma wal-hazan
25.26.en: (I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah.) In the name of Allah, besides whom none has the right to be worshipped, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. O Allah, remove from me worry and grief.

25.31.tren: Allahummaj-'al khayra 'umri akhirahu, wa khayra 'amali khawatimahu, wa khayra ayyami yawma alqak
25.31.en: O Allah, make the best of my life its end, the best of my deeds their conclusions, and the best of my days the day I meet You.

25.27.tren: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'amalin yukhzini, Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min ghinan yutghini, Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min sahibin yurdini, Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min amalin yulhini, Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min faqrin yunsini
25.27.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from any deed that would disgrace me. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from any wealth that would make me transgress. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from any companion who would ruin me. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from any hope that would distract me. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from any poverty that would make me forget (You).

25.28.tren: Allahumma astaghfiruka li-dhanbi, wa astahdika li-arshadi amri, wa atubu ilayka fatub 'alayya. Allahumma anta rabbi, faj'al raghbati ilayk, waj'al ghina'i fi sadri, wa barik li fima razaqtani, wa taqabbal minni, innaka anta rabbi
25.28.en: O Allah, I seek Your forgiveness for my sin, I ask You to guide me to the most upright of my affairs, and I repent to You, so accept my repentance. O Allah, You are my Lord, so make my longing be for You, place my sufficiency in my heart, bless me in what You have provided me, and accept from me; indeed, You are my Lord.

25.29.tren: Bihamdi rabbiyan-saraftu, wa bidhunubiya'-taraftu, a'udhu birabbi min sharri maq-taraftu. Ya muqallibal-qulub, qallib qalbi 'ala ma tuhibbu wa tarda
25.29.en: With the praise of my Lord I have finished (the prayer), and I confess my sins. I seek refuge in my Lord from the evil of what I have committed. O Turner of hearts, turn my heart to what You love and are pleased with.

25.30.tren: Subhanallah · Alhamdu lillah · Allahu akbar · La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir · La ilaha illallah
25.30.en: [After Fajr and after Asr] Glory be to Allah (100 times) · All praise is for Allah (100 times) · Allah is the Greatest (100 times) · None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. (100 times) · Or: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah (100 times)

27.26.en: O Allah, protect me from the Fire.

27.27.en: [Say once in the morning] O Allah, I have given my honour in charity to Your servants.

27.28.tren: Huwallahul-ladhi la ilaha illa huw, 'alimul-ghaybi wash-shahadah, huwar-Rahmanur-Rahim. Huwallahul-ladhi la ilaha illa huw, al-Malikul-Quddusus-Salamul-Mu'minul-Muhayminul-'Azizul-Jabbarul-Mutakabbir, subhanallahi 'amma yushrikun. Huwallahul-Khaliqul-Bari'ul-Musawwiru lahul-asma'ul-husna, yusabbihu lahu ma fis-samawati wal-ard, wa huwal-'Azizul-Hakim
27.28.en: [The last three verses of Surah Al-Hashr] He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Bestower of Faith, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him. He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

28.19.en: [Surah Al-Kafirun] In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. Say, "O disbelievers, I do not worship what you worship. Nor are you worshippers of what I worship. Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship. Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship. For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."

28.18.en: [Surah Al-Ikhlas] In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there to Him any equivalent."

28.14.tren: Bismika rabbi wada'tu janbi faghfir li dhanbi
28.14.en: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side, so forgive me my sin.

28.15.tren: Allahumma amti'ni bisam'i wa basari waj'alhumal-waritha minni. Allahumman-surni 'ala 'aduwwi wa arini fihi tha'ri. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min ghalabatid-dayn, wa minal-ju'i fa innahu bi'sad-daji'
28.15.en: O Allah, let me enjoy my hearing and my sight, and make them remain with me until my death. O Allah, help me against my enemy and show me my vengeance on him. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from being overwhelmed by debt, and from hunger, for it is an evil bedfellow.

28.16.tren: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammatil-lati la yujawizuhunna barrun wa la fajir, min sharri ma khalaqa wa dhara'a wa bara', wa min sharri ma yanzilu minas-sama', wa min sharri ma ya'ruju fiha, wa min sharri ma dhara'a fil-ard, wa min sharri ma yakhruju minha, wa min sharril-layli wan-nahar, wa min sharri kulli tariqin illa tariqan yatruqu bikhayrin ya Rahman
28.16.en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah, which no righteous or wicked person can go beyond, from the evil of what He has created, made and brought into being, from the evil of what descends from the sky and the evil of what ascends into it, from the evil of what He has spread on the earth and the evil of what comes out of it, from the evil of the night and the day, and from the evil of every night visitor, except a visitor who comes with good, O Most Merciful.

28.17.tren: Bismillahi wada'tu janbi. Allahummagh-fir li dhanbi, wa akhsi' shaytani, wa fukka rihani, waj'alni fin-nadiyyil-a'la
28.17.en: In the name of Allah I lay down my side. O Allah, forgive me my sin, drive away my devil, release me from my bond, and place me in the highest assembly.

32.4.tren: (Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim) Allahumma inna nasta'inuka wa nastaghfiruka wa nuthni 'alayka (wa nashkuruka) wa la nakfuruka, wa nakhla'u wa natruku man yafjuruk. Allahumma iyyaka na'budu wa laka nusalli wa nasjudu wa laka nas'a wa nahfid, nakhsha 'adhabakal-jidda wa narju rahmatak, inna 'adhabaka bil-kafirina mulhiq. Allahummagh-fir lana wa lil-mu'minina wal-mu'minati wal-muslimina wal-muslimat, wa allif bayna qulubihim, wa aslih dhata baynihim, wansurhum 'ala 'aduwwika wa 'aduwwihim. Allahummal-'an kafarata ahlil-kitabil-ladhina yasudduna 'an sabilika wa yukadhdhibuna rusulaka wa yuqatiluna awliya'ak. Allahumma khalif bayna kalimatihim, wa zalzil aqdamahum, wa anzil bihim ba'sakal-ladhi la taruddu 'anil-qawmil-mujrimin
32.4.en: (In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.) O Allah, we seek Your help and ask Your forgiveness, we praise You (and thank You), and we do not disbelieve in You, and we disown and forsake whoever disobeys You. O Allah, You alone we worship, to You we pray and prostrate, and for You we strive and hasten to serve. We fear Your true punishment and hope for Your mercy; indeed, Your punishment will overtake the disbelievers. O Allah, forgive us and the believing men and women and the Muslim men and women, join their hearts together, set right their relations with one another, and help them against Your enemy and theirs. O Allah, curse the disbelievers among the People of the Book who turn people away from Your path, deny Your messengers and fight Your allies. O Allah, cause discord among them, make their feet tremble, and send down upon them Your punishment which You do not turn away from the criminal people.

32.5.tren: Rabbi a'inni wa la tu'in 'alayya, wansurni wa la tansur 'alayya, wamkur li wa la tamkur 'alayya, wahdini wa yassiril-huda li (ilayya), wansurni 'ala man bagha 'alayya. Rabbij-'alni laka shakkaran, laka dhakkaran, laka rahhaban, laka mitwa'an, laka mukhbitan, ilayka awwahan muniba. Rabbi taqabbal tawbati, waghsil hawbati, wa ajib da'wati, wa thabbit hujjati, wa saddid lisani, wahdi qalbi, waslul sakhimata qalbi (sadri)
32.5.en: My Lord, help me and do not help others against me; support me and do not support others against me; plan for me and do not plan against me; guide me and make guidance easy for me; and support me against whoever transgresses against me. My Lord, make me ever grateful to You, ever remembering You, ever fearing You, ever obedient to You, humble before You, and ever turning to You in contrition and repentance. My Lord, accept my repentance, wash away my sin, answer my supplication, establish my proof, keep my tongue upright, guide my heart, and remove the rancour from my heart (breast).

45.1.en: [Seek refuge in Allah from him, saying:] I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed devil.

50.1.tren: La ba'sa, tahurun in sha' Allah
50.1.en: No harm; (it is) a purification, if Allah wills.

50.2.en: [The Prophet ﷺ said: whoever visits a sick person whose death is not near and says this supplication in his presence] I ask Allah the Mighty, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to cure you.

55.5.tren: Allahumma (innahu) 'abduka wabnu 'abdika wabnu amatik, kana yashhadu an la ilaha illa anta wa anna Muhammadan 'abduka wa rasuluk, wa anta a'lamu bih. Allahumma in kana muhsinan fazid fi ihsanihi, wa in kana musi'an fatajawaz 'an sayyi'atih. Allahumma la tahrimna ajrahu wa la taftinna ba'dah
55.5.en: O Allah, (he is) Your servant, the son of Your male servant and the son of Your female servant. He used to bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You and that Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger, and You know him best. O Allah, if he was a doer of good, then increase his good deeds, and if he was a wrongdoer, then overlook his evil deeds. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward, and do not put us to trial after him.

55.6.tren: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Al-hamdu lillahi, wa subhanallahi, wa la ilaha illallahu, wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
55.6.en: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. All praise is for Allah, glory be to Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no might and no power except by Allah.

56.3.tren: Allahummaj-'alhu lana faratan wa salafan wa ajra
56.3.en: O Allah, make him for us a forerunner, a precursor and a reward.

57.2.tren: A'zamallahu ajrak, wa ahsana 'aza'ak, wa ghafara li-mayyitik
57.2.en: [It is also good to say:] May Allah make your reward great, make your consolation good, and forgive your deceased.

58.2.tren: Anna Rasulallahi (sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam) salla 'ala janazatin thumma ata qabral-mayyiti fahatha 'alayhi min qibali ra'sihi thalatha
58.2.en: [It is reported in an authentic hadith that, after the deceased has been buried, it is Sunnah for those present to throw three double handfuls of soil into the grave] The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prayed over a funeral, then came to the grave of the deceased and threw (soil) onto it from the side of his head three times.

59.2.en: The Tabi'i 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Shimasah al-Mahri said: At the time of his death, the Companion 'Amr ibn al-'As (may Allah be pleased with him) told us: "After I am buried, stay by my grave for as long as it takes to slaughter a camel and distribute its meat, so that I may find comfort in your presence and consider what answer I will give to the messengers of my Lord." From this we learn that it is good to remain by the grave for a while after burial, so that the deceased may be strengthened in answering the angels' questions. In another hadith, 'Uthman ibn 'Affan (may Allah be pleased with him) said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ finished burying the deceased, he would stand over the grave and say: "Seek forgiveness for your brother and pray for his firmness (in faith)." (Sahih.) Following this guidance, a believer may pray in any language and with any words for the forgiveness of the one buried and for his firmness in answering the angels, e.g. "May Allah forgive him and make the questioning easy for him." Since the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not teach any particular wording here, no fixed wording should be specified. A hadith about calling out to the buried person after burial to remind him of faith and the kalimah is narrated with a very weak chain; An-Nawawi, Ibn al-Qayyim, Al-'Iraqi, Al-Haythami, Ibn Hajar al-'Asqalani, As-Sakhawi and other hadith scholars all declared it weak or very weak. A believer should not establish a practice in society based on such a weak hadith, but should keep to the supplication indicated by the sahih hadith above.

60.2.tren: As-salamu 'alaykum dara qawmin mu'minin, wa inna in sha' Allahu bikum lahiqun
60.2.en: Peace be upon you, abode of believing people, and we, if Allah wills, will join you.

60.3.tren: As-salamu 'alaykum ya ahlal-qubur, yaghfirullahu lana wa lakum, antum salafuna wa nahnu bil-athar
60.3.en: Peace be upon you, O inhabitants of the graves. May Allah forgive us and you. You have gone before us and we are following behind.

60.4.tren: As-salamu 'alaykum dara qawmin mu'minin, wa atakum ma tu'aduna ghadan mu'ajjalun, wa inna in sha' Allahu bikum lahiqun. Allahummagh-fir li-ahli Baqi'il-Gharqad
60.4.en: Peace be upon you, abode of believing people. What you were promised has come to you, deferred until tomorrow, and we, if Allah wills, will join you. O Allah, forgive the people of Baqi' al-Gharqad.

84.2.tren: Allahummaq-sim lana min khashyatika ma yahulu baynana wa bayna ma'asik, wa min ta'atika ma tuballighuna bihi jannatak, wa minal-yaqini ma tuhawwinu bihi 'alayna masa'ibad-dunya, wa matti'na bi-asma'ina wa absarina wa quwwatina ma ahyaytana, waj'alhul-waritha minna, waj'al tha'rana 'ala man zalamana, wansurna 'ala man 'adana, wa la taj'al musibatana fi dinina, wa la taj'alid-dunya akbara hammina wa la mablagha 'ilmina, wa la tusallit 'alayna man la yarhamuna
84.2.en: O Allah, grant us enough fear of You to come between us and disobedience to You, enough obedience to You to bring us to Your Paradise, and enough certainty to make the calamities of this world easy for us. Let us enjoy our hearing, our sight and our strength as long as You keep us alive, and make them remain with us until our death. Direct our vengeance against those who have wronged us, and support us against those who are hostile to us. Do not let our calamity be in our religion, do not make this world our greatest concern nor the limit of our knowledge, and do not give power over us to those who will not show us mercy.

98.2.tren: Allahumma inni as'aluka min khayriha wa khayri ahliha, wa a'udhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ahliha
98.2.en: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this place and the good of its people, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil of its people.

102.1.en: [Jabir (may Allah be pleased with him) said: When we went up a height we would say:] Allah is the Greatest · [And when we went down we would say:] Glory be to Allah

107.2.en: O Possessor of Majesty and Honour.

120.1.tren: Allahu akbar · La ilaha illallah · Allahu ahad
120.1.en: [The Prophet ﷺ rode Al-Qaswa' until he came to Al-Mash'ar Al-Haram (a place in Muzdalifah); there he faced the Qiblah, supplicated, said takbir and tahlil, and declared Allah's Oneness:] Allah is the Greatest · None has the right to be worshipped except Allah · Allah is One

121.1.en: [The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would say with each pebble he threw at the three Jamarat:] Allah is the Greatest.

125.1.en: [When one of you sees something in his brother, in himself or in his wealth that impresses him, let him say:] May Allah bless you.

129.2.tren: Rabbigh-fir li wa tub 'alayya innaka (anta) at-Tawwabur-Rahim (al-Ghafur)
129.2.en: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance; indeed, You are the Accepter of Repentance, the Most Merciful (in another narration: the Accepter of Repentance, the Most Forgiving).

129.3.tren: La ilaha illallahu wallahu akbar, la ilaha illallahu wahdah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, la ilaha illallahu lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, la ilaha illallahu wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
129.3.en: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the Greatest. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah; to Him belongs all sovereignty and to Him belongs all praise. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and there is no might and no power except by Allah.

130.12.en: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.

130.13.tren: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu (yuhyi wa yumitu wa huwa hayyun la yamutu, biyadihil-khayr) wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
130.13.en: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise (He gives life and causes death, and He is Ever-Living and does not die; in His Hand is all good), and He is over all things omnipotent.

130.14.en: Glory be to Allah the Magnificent.

130.15.en: Glory be to Allah the Magnificent, and praise be to Him.

131.1.en: 'Abdullah ibn 'Amr (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: "I saw the Prophet ﷺ counting tasbih by folding his fingers." Another narration adds: "with his right hand."

132.2.tren: Ahsibu fulanan, wallahu hasibuhu, wa la uzakki 'alallahi ahadan, ahsibuhu kadha wa kadha
132.2.en: [Backbiting someone and praising someone lavishly to his face are both wrong; one should not declare anyone to be definitely good. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: if you must praise someone, say:] I think so-and-so is such, and Allah is his Reckoner, and I do not vouch for anyone before Allah; I think him to be such and such.

132.3.tren: Allahumma la tu'akhidhni bima yaquluna, waghfir li ma la ya'lamuna (waj'alni khayran mimma yazunnun)
132.3.en: [When the Companions and the Tabi'in were called pious or praised, it grieved them, and they would say:] O Allah, do not take me to account for what they say, and forgive me for what they do not know (and make me better than what they think).

149.1.tren: Rabbana amanna faktubna ma'ash-shahidin · Wa ma lana la nu'minu billahi wa ma ja'ana minal-haqqi wa natma'u an yudkhilana rabbuna ma'al-qawmis-salihin
149.1.en: Our Lord, we have believed, so register us among the witnesses. · And why should we not believe in Allah and what has come to us of the truth? And we aspire that our Lord will admit us [to Paradise] with the righteous people.
149.1.ch: Dua for Attaining the Rank of the Shuhada [5:83–84]

210.1.en: O Allah, You are Pardoning (Generous), You love to pardon, so pardon me.

211.1.tren: Adh-hibil-ba'sa rabban-nas, washfi antash-Shafi, la shifa'a illa shifa'uk, shifa'an la yughadiru saqama
211.1.en: [When performing ruqyah for one of his wives, the Prophet ﷺ would wipe with his right hand and say:] Remove the harm, O Lord of mankind, and heal, for You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing, a healing that leaves no illness behind.

211.2.tren: Bismillahi arqik, min kulli shay'in yu'dhik, min sharri kulli nafsin aw 'aynin hasid, Allahu yashfik, bismillahi arqik
211.2.en: In the name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you, from everything that harms you, from the evil of every soul or envious eye. May Allah cure you. In the name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you.

211.3.tren: Bismillah, turbatu ardina, biriqati ba'dina, yushfa (bihi) saqimuna, bi-idhni rabbina
211.3.en: In the name of Allah, the soil of our land, with the saliva of some of us, (by it) our sick one is cured, by the permission of our Lord.

211.4.tren: Recite Surah Al-Ikhlas · Recite Surah Al-Falaq · Recite Surah An-Nas
211.4.en: [Al-Mu'awwidhat: Surah Al-Ikhlas, Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas] In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there to Him any equivalent." · In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of that which He created, and from the evil of darkness when it settles, and from the evil of the blowers in knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies." · In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the Sovereign of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer – who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind – from among the jinn and mankind."

211.5.tren: Bismillahil-Kabir, a'udhu billahil-'Azim min sharri kulli 'irqin na''ar, wa min sharri harrin-nar
211.5.en: In the name of Allah the Great. I seek refuge in Allah the Magnificent from the evil of every gushing vein, and from the evil of the heat of the Fire.

211.6.en: Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out (to the mosque) at the beginning of midday, and I also came at that time. I prayed (tahiyyat al-masjid) and sat down. He looked at me and said: 'Are you suffering from stomach pain?' I said: 'Yes.' He said: 'Stand up and pray, for in prayer there is healing.'" The chain of this hadith is weak.

212.1.tren: Recite Surah Al-Falaq · Recite Surah An-Nas
212.1.en: [Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas] In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of that which He created, and from the evil of darkness when it settles, and from the evil of the blowers in knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies." · In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the Sovereign of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer – who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind – from among the jinn and mankind."

213.1.en: For a venomous bite or sting from a snake, scorpion and the like, one should quickly seek medicine and treatment, and also recite supplications. We have seen that a Companion treated a person bitten by a snake by reciting Surah Al-Fatihah. In another hadith, 'Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) said: "One night the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was praying. During the prayer he placed his hand on the ground, and a scorpion stung him. He took hold of the scorpion with his sandal and killed it. After finishing the prayer he said: 'The accursed scorpion! It spares neither one who prays nor one who does not (or: neither a prophet nor anyone else).' Then he asked for water and salt. He mixed the water and salt in a vessel, poured it over his stung finger, wiped over it, and supplicated reciting Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas. In another narration: he recited Surah Al-Kafirun, Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas." The hadith is sahih.
213.1.ch: Dua for Venomous Bites and Stings

214.1.tren: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin
214.1.en: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

215.1.tren: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin 'abdika wa rasulik, wa salli 'alal-mu'minina wal-mu'minat, wal-muslimina wal-muslimat
215.1.en: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad, Your servant and Messenger, and send prayers upon the believing men and the believing women, and the Muslim men and the Muslim women.
215.1.ch: Importance and Virtue of Reciting Salat (Durood)

215.2.tren: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa anzilhul-maq'adal-muqarraba 'indaka yawmal-qiyamah
215.2.en: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and grant him the seat of nearness to You on the Day of Resurrection.
215.2.ch: Importance and Virtue of Reciting Salat (Durood)

215.3.tren: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin 'abdika wa nabiyyika wa rasulikan-nabiyyil-ummiyy
215.3.en: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad, Your servant, Your Prophet and Your Messenger, the unlettered Prophet.
215.3.ch: Importance and Virtue of Reciting Salat (Durood)

216.1.tren: Allahumma a'udhu bika min jahdil-bala'i, wa darakish-shaqa'i, wa su'il-qada'i, wa shamatatil-a'da'
216.1.en: [These supplications may be recited in sujood, in the final sitting before the salam, after the salam, and at any time] O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of affliction, from being overtaken by misery, from an evil decree, and from the gloating of enemies.

216.2.tren: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasali wal-jubni wal-bukhli wal-harami wa 'adhabil-qabr. Allahumma ati nafsi taqwaha, wa zakkiha anta khayru man zakkaha, anta waliyyuha wa mawlaha. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'ilmin la yanfa', wa min qalbin la yakhsha', wa min nafsin la tashba', wa min da'watin la yustajabu laha
216.2.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from incapacity, laziness, cowardice, miserliness, decrepit old age and the punishment of the grave. O Allah, grant my soul its piety and purify it, for You are the best of those who purify it; You are its Guardian and its Protector. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that does not benefit, from a heart that does not humble itself, from a soul that is never satisfied, and from a supplication that is not answered.

216.3.tren: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min zawali ni'matik, wa tahawwuli 'afiyatik, wa fuja'ati niqmatik, wa jami'i sakhatik
216.3.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the loss of Your blessings, the change of the well-being You have granted, the suddenness of Your punishment, and all forms of Your displeasure.

216.4.tren: Allahummar-zuqni hubbaka wa hubba man yanfa'uni hubbuhu 'indak. Allahumma ma razaqtani mimma uhibbu faj'alhu quwwatan li fima tuhibb. Allahumma wa ma zawayta 'anni mimma uhibbu faj'alhu faraghan li fima tuhibb
216.4.en: O Allah, grant me Your love and the love of those whose love will benefit me with You. O Allah, whatever You have provided me of what I love, make it a strength for me in what You love. O Allah, and whatever You have withheld from me of what I love, make it free time for me for what You love.

216.5.tren: Allahumma zidna wa la tanqusna, wa akrimna wa la tuhinna, wa a'tina wa la tahrimna, wa athirna wa la tu'thir 'alayna, wa ardina wa-rda 'anna
216.5.en: O Allah, increase us and do not decrease us, honour us and do not disgrace us, give to us and do not deprive us, favour us and do not favour others over us, and make us pleased and be pleased with us.

216.6.tren: Allahumma inni as'alukal-huda wat-tuqa wal-'afafa wal-ghina
216.6.en: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity and self-sufficiency.

216.7.en: O Turner of hearts, keep my heart firm upon Your religion.

216.8.tren: Allahumma ahsin 'aqibatana fil-umuri kulliha, wa ajirna min khizyid-dunya wa 'adhabil-akhirah
216.8.en: O Allah, make good our outcome in all matters, and protect us from the disgrace of this world and the punishment of the Hereafter.

216.9.tren: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-barasi wal-jununi wal-judhami wa min sayyi'il-asqam
216.9.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from leukoderma, madness, leprosy, and from all evil diseases.

216.10.tren: Allahummah-fazni bil-islami qa'iman, wahfazni bil-islami qa'idan, wahfazni bil-islami raqidan, wa la tushmit bi 'aduwwan wa la hasida. Allahumma inni as'aluka min kulli khayrin khaza'inuhu biyadik, wa a'udhu bika min kulli sharrin khaza'inuhu biyadik
216.10.en: O Allah, protect me with Islam while standing, protect me with Islam while sitting, and protect me with Islam while lying down, and do not let any enemy or envier rejoice at my misfortune. O Allah, I ask You for every good whose treasures are in Your Hand, and I seek refuge in You from every evil whose treasures are in Your Hand.

216.11.tren: Allahummaj-'al awsa'a rizqika 'alayya 'inda kibari sinni wanqita'i 'umri
216.11.en: O Allah, make Your most abundant provision for me be when I reach old age and at the end of my life.

216.12.tren: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasali wal-jubni wal-bukhli wal-harami wal-qaswati wal-ghaflati wal-'aylati wadh-dhillati wal-maskanah, wa a'udhu bika minal-faqri wal-kufri wal-fusuqi wash-shiqaqi wan-nifaqi was-sum'ati war-riya', wa a'udhu bika minas-samami wal-bakami wal-jununi wal-judhami wal-barasi wa sayyi'il-asqam
216.12.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from incapacity, laziness, cowardice, miserliness, decrepit old age, hard-heartedness, heedlessness, destitution, humiliation and wretchedness. I seek refuge in You from poverty, disbelief, sinfulness, discord, hypocrisy, seeking reputation and showing off. And I seek refuge in You from deafness, muteness, madness, leprosy, leukoderma and all evil diseases.

216.13.tren: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min yawmis-su', wa min laylatis-su', wa min sa'atis-su', wa min sahibis-su', wa min jaris-su'i fi daril-muqamah
216.13.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from an evil day, an evil night, an evil hour, an evil companion, and an evil neighbour in the place of residence.

216.14.tren: Allahumman-fa'ni bima 'allamtani, wa 'allimni ma yanfa'uni, wa zidni 'ilma
216.14.en: O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, teach me what will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge.

216.15.tren: Allahumma matti'ni bisam'i wa basari waj'alhumal-waritha minni, wansurni 'ala man zalamani, wa khudh minhu bitha'ri
216.15.en: O Allah, let me enjoy my hearing and my sight and make them remain with me until my death; help me against whoever wrongs me, and take my revenge on him.

217.1.tren: Al-hamdu lillahi 'adada ma ahsa kitabuh · Wal-hamdu lillahi mil'a ma ahsa kitabuh · Wal-hamdu lillahi 'adada ma ahsa khalquh · Wal-hamdu lillahi mil'a ma fi khalqih · Wal-hamdu lillahi mil'a samawatihi wa ardih · Wal-hamdu lillahi 'adada kulli shay' · Wal-hamdu lillahi 'ala kulli shay'
217.1.en: All praise is for Allah, as many as what His Book has enumerated · And all praise is for Allah, filling what His Book has enumerated · And all praise is for Allah, as many as what His creation has enumerated · And all praise is for Allah, filling all that is in His creation · And all praise is for Allah, filling His heavens and His earth · And all praise is for Allah, as many as all things · And all praise is for Allah for all things

217.2.tren: Al-hamdu lillahi hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fih
217.2.en: All praise is for Allah, abundant, good and blessed praise.

217.3.en: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all.

218.1.tren: Subhanallah · Alhamdu lillah · Allahu akbar · La ilaha illallah
218.1.en: [100 times each] Glory be to Allah · All praise is for Allah · Allah is the Greatest · None has the right to be worshipped except Allah
218.1.ch: Four Kinds of Dhikr, 100 Times Each
